podcast.body: This album featured collaborations with various artists, including Sum 41 and Green Day. Derek Whibley, producer Greg Norrie, and Iggy Pop co-wrote the track "Little Know It All" for this release. "Iggy Pop started calling around for guest help on his skull ring album."

podcast.body: This album was released under Iggy Pop's name after Virgin Records suggested he incorporate guest musicians, specifically hinting at the "Ashton Boys," to generate buzz for his next record and avoid being dropped. Ron and Scott Ashton appeared on four songs, marking a close, but not official, reunion of the band members. "Ron and Scott appeared on four songs in a record that was eventually released under the title Skull Ring."
